scope: retained and segmented DisplayFormat reads; CF source A1 distinct from consumer B1

probes.name: worksheet-cached-display
probes.source:
Public SourceCell As Range
Public Cached As Object
Public LastDetail As String
Public Calls As Long
Public AccessKind As String
Public FreshAccess As Boolean
Function ReadRetained() As Variant
Dim obj As Object,child As Object,v As Variant
Dim stage As String,kind As String,childKind As String,callerKind As String,sameBook As String,n As Long
On Error GoTo Failed
Calls=Calls+1
stage="caller"
callerKind=TypeName(Application.Caller)
sameBook=CStr(SourceCell.Parent.Parent Is Application.Caller.Parent.Parent)
stage="acquire"
If FreshAccess Then
Set obj=SourceCell.DisplayFormat
Else
Set obj=Cached
End If
kind=TypeName(obj)
stage="child"
Select Case AccessKind
Case "display"
Set child=obj.Font
Case "borders"
Set child=obj.Item(xlEdgeBottom)
Case Else
Set child=obj
End Select
childKind=TypeName(child)
stage="read"
If AccessKind="display" Or AccessKind="font" Then
v=child.Bold
Else
v=child.Color
End If
LastDetail="err=0;stage=done;object=" & kind & ";child=" & childKind & ";read=" & CStr(v) & ";caller=" & callerKind & ";samebook=" & sameBook
ReadRetained=True
Exit Function
Failed:
n=Err.Number
LastDetail="err=" & CStr(n) & ";stage=" & stage & ";object=" & kind & ";child=" & childKind & ";caller=" & callerKind & ";samebook=" & sameBook
ReadRetained=CVErr(2015)
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim host As Workbook,other As Workbook,consumer As Range,f As FormatCondition
Dim v As Variant,shown As String,n As Long
On Error GoTo Failed
Set host=Application.ActiveWorkbook
Set SourceCell=host.Worksheets(1).Range("A1")
SourceCell.Value=7
SourceCell.Font.Bold=False
Set f=SourceCell.FormatConditions.Add(xlExpression,Formula1:="=TRUE")
f.Font.Bold=True
f.Interior.Color=vbRed
f.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbBlue
AccessKind="display"
FreshAccess=False
Set Cached=SourceCell.DisplayFormat
host.Activate
Set consumer=host.Worksheets(1).Range("B1")
consumer.Formula="=ReadRetained()"
Application.CalculateFull
v=consumer.Value2
shown=consumer.Text
Probe="value=" & CStr(v) & ";vartype=" & CStr(VarType(v)) & ";text=" & shown & ";called=" & CStr(Calls>0) & ";" & LastDetail
GoTo Cleanup
Failed:
n=Err.Number
Probe="PROBE-ERR:" & CStr(n) & ";called=" & CStr(Calls>0) & ";" & LastDetail
Cleanup:
On Error Resume Next
Set Cached=Nothing
Set SourceCell=Nothing
If Not other Is Nothing Then other.Close SaveChanges:=False
host.Activate
End Function
